title: 第三章 猫头鹰商店
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
这时游戏中又弹出了新的文本。
【你在逃犯离开的位置，发现了一根类似树枝的东西，你捡起来一看，原来是一根老旧的魔杖！】
【老旧的魔杖：这是一根用最廉价的红橡树枝做成的垃圾魔杖，没有任何附加属性，且表面斑驳的痕迹，说明它使用年限已久，随时有可能寿终正寝，如果有的选，你最好换一根新的。】
还有意外收获？
沐游眼睛一亮，点击了‘魔杖’的文本。
一根弯弯曲曲的树枝，悄然出现在他手中。
三十厘米左右的长度，表面不少地方已经有了腐朽的痕迹，粗糙的就像从枯树上随意折下的一根枝条。
“这就是魔杖？”
沐游将树枝拿在手里摆弄了一会儿，又试着朝前挥出几下，结果毫无反应。
他只好又看向游戏里的文本。
【魔杖是巫师释放魔法所必须的工具，但想要释放出魔法，你还需要先学会至少一条咒语。】
“果然需要咒语么……”
沐游叹了口气，显然魔杖只是个工具，魔法咒语才是根本，单这一根魔杖，对他来说作用为零。
“咒语咒语，我要咒语，给我来条咒语吧！随便什么都行！”
沐游嘴里碎碎念着，继续游戏。
【你获得了人生的第一根魔杖！这让你得到了莫大的激励，虽然你还不会任何魔法，但你已经成为在大巫师的道路，走出了坚实的第一步！】
【自信在你的心中发芽，野心开始在你的胸中膨胀。你豪气万千的穿过中间的小路，如同一位开疆扩土的君王！】
【前方草丛中忽然蹿出一条毒蛇。】
【你被毒蛇咬死了！】
【你已死亡！寿命-1，剩余寿命57年。】

“靠！”
沐游傻眼，又暴毙了！
但是，是不是有哪里不太对……
——特么的选项呢！？
他怀表还没用呢，怎么忽然就被咬死了？
沐游刚才还在想，有怀表在手，这游戏他根本不可能死，结果立马就被打了脸。
居然还有这种连选项都没有的死亡方式……太不讲武德了！
这种死亡方式下，他的怀表都没用了，因为就算回溯了时间，游戏中他也做不了别的选择，只能继续往前走，然后再将死亡的过程重复一遍而已。
沐游骂骂咧咧，一边骂却也只能一边继续玩。
虽然损失了一年寿命，但毕竟已经得到了一块逆天的怀表和一根魔杖，现在让他收手，还真有点舍不得。
【在星灵界的规则中，死亡并非终结，这个世界的所有生物，每次死亡都会减少一年寿命，并在最近的出生点处复活。】
【只有当寿命低于零时，你才会彻底消失在这个世界！】
游戏中先是弹出了一段说明。
和他之前想的一样，果然这游戏每次死亡都会减少一年寿命。
而他现在寿命是57年，也就是说，他还有57条命可以浪……
“没关系，才少了一条命而已，我还有的是！”
沐游安慰着自己，继续上路。
【死亡的痛楚过后，你在上一个路口复活。】
【你重新出发，漫步在大雪覆盖的森林中。】
【你看到一只小白兔趴在路边吃草，可爱的模样，让你不由想起了麻辣兔头的味道，忍不住靠近了它。】

【小白兔发现了你，小白兔对你发动了‘野蛮冲撞’。】
【你被小白兔撞死了！】
【你已死亡！寿命-1，当前寿命：56年。】
wtf？
沐游差点没当场把手机砸了。
你这游戏果然有毒吧！
谁要吃麻辣兔头了，我要苟命好不好？走位风骚一点好不好？
连续两次直接死亡，让沐游心都在滴血。
他终于感受到了这个游戏对玩家满满的恶意，这才刚走几步，就连坑他两条命，以后还不定要怎么戏耍他呢！
可惜游戏并没有给他太多吐槽的时间，新的文本已经弹出。
【寒风呼啸之中，你又一次在路口复活。】
【再次死亡的经历，终于让你认识到了自己的渺小。在这个诡谲黑暗的魔法世界，身为愚者的你，是最底层最卑微的存在，哪怕是路边的一只兔子，也不是你能够对付的！】
看着这欠儿巴巴的文本，沐游好险才忍住骂街的冲动。
他其实很好奇，那个世界的他究竟是个什么状态？打不过蝙蝠毒蛇也就算了，但连只兔子都打不过，他得弱鸡成什么样？
【休整完毕，你再次出发，踏上寻找村庄的路途，这次，你将更加谨慎。】
【你又一次来到了刚才的小路上，看着前方那只人蓄无害的小白兔，你选择了远远绕开。】
【兔子很快消失在你的视野，你松了口气，继续向前，忽然看到一间木屋商店，突兀的矗立在前方的路口，木屋顶端挂着一个猫头鹰形状的招牌，上面写着‘猫头鹰商店’。】
【路边商店的老板是一只长着猫头鹰脸的人，它看到了你，并朝你打招呼：“你好冒险者，我这儿卖的都是货真价实的宝物，走过路过，不要错过！”】
【是否进入‘猫头鹰商店’？】
前方好像出现了一个类似路边摊的小商店，但老板却是个诡异的猫头鹰人，不知道会不会又是陷阱。

被坑怕了的沐游选择了【进入商店】，同时右手牢牢握住怀表，准备一有异常立刻回档。
好在，想象中他刚进店就被一大群猫头鹰咬死的情况没有发生，这似乎真是个可以安全交易的场所。
【你进入了商店，看到商店的橱窗上摆放有三件商品。】
【烧烧卷轴：一张记载了魔法咒语的卷轴，使用后可学会低级火系咒语‘火焰熊熊’。价值：100年寿命】
【隐形斗篷：正如它的名字，穿上后可以让你隐形，但斗篷无法掩盖你的声音和气味。价值：55年寿命】
【充能魔杖：这是一根特殊的魔杖，每当附近有人释放魔法时，它都会吸收散溢的魔力并充能一格，充满五格后，可以无消耗释放一次高威力的电击魔法，并清空充能。价值：70年寿命。】
“都是好东西啊！”
沐游馋的口水都快流下来了，可惜，他一件都买不起……
即使最便宜的隐形斗篷，也要55年寿命，而他现在总共也只有56年，买完就剩一丝血皮，随便被路边的野怪挠一下就死了，就算给他十个胆子，他也不敢玩这么大！
content_en:
At this time, new text popped up in the game.
[You found something like a branch where the fugitive left. You picked it up and saw that it was an old wand! 】
[Old wand: This is a junk wand made of the cheapest red oak branches. It has no additional attributes, and the mottled marks on the surface indicate that it has been used for a long time and may end its life at any time. If you have the option, you'd better get a new one. 】
Any unexpected gains?
Mu You's eyes lit up and he clicked on the text of 'Magic Wand'.
A crooked branch quietly appeared in his hand.
It was about thirty centimeters in length, and there were signs of decay in many places on the surface. It was as rough as a branch randomly broken off from a dead tree.
"Is this the wand?"
Mu You held the branch in his hand and played with it for a while, then tried swinging it forward a few times, but there was no response.
He had no choice but to look at the text in the game again.
[The wand is a necessary tool for wizards to release magic, but in order to release magic, you need to learn at least one spell first. 】
"Do you really need a spell..."
Mu You sighed. Obviously the wand was just a tool, and magic spells were the foundation. This wand alone had zero effect on him.
"A spell, a spell, I want a spell, give me a spell! Anything!"
Mu You muttered to himself and continued the game.
【You got your first magic wand! This gives you great motivation. Although you don’t know any magic yet, you have already taken a solid first step on the road to being a great wizard! 】
[Confidence sprouts in your heart, and ambition begins to expand in your chest. You walked through the middle path with great heroism, like a king expanding his territory! 】
[A venomous snake suddenly jumped out from the grass ahead. 】
[You were bitten to death by a poisonous snake! 】
【You are dead! Lifespan -1, remaining lifespan is 57 years. 】
"Fuck!"
Mu You was dumbfounded and died suddenly again!
But, is there something wrong...
——What a special option! ?
He didn't even use his pocket watch, so why was he suddenly bitten to death?
Mu You was thinking just now that with the pocket watch in his hand, it was impossible for him to die in this game, but he was immediately slapped in the face.
There is such a way of death that doesn't even have options... It's so disrespectful of martial ethics!
In this way of death, his pocket watch is useless, because even if he goes back in time, he has no other choice in the game. He can only continue to move forward, and then repeat the death process all over again.
Mu You cursed, but he could only continue playing while cursing.
Although he lost a year of his life, he had already obtained a heaven-defying pocket watch and a magic wand. It was really hard for him to stop now.
[In the rules of the star spirit world, death is not the end. All creatures in this world will lose one year of life every time they die and will be resurrected at the nearest point of birth. 】
[Only when your life span is lower than zero, you will completely disappear from this world! 】
A description first popped up in the game.
As he thought before, every time you die in this game, your life span will be reduced by one year.
And his current life span is 57 years, which means he still has 57 lives to waste...
"It doesn't matter, I just lost one life, I still have more!"
Mu You comforted himself and continued on his way.
[After the pain of death, you are resurrected at the last intersection. 】
[You start again and walk in the snow-covered forest. 】
[You see a little white rabbit lying on the roadside eating grass. Its cute appearance reminds you of the spicy rabbit head, and you can't help but get closer to it. 】
[The little white rabbit discovered you, and the little white rabbit launched a ‘savage charge’ against you. 】
【You were hit by the little white rabbit! 】
【You are dead! Lifespan -1, current lifespan: 56 years. 】
wtf?
Mu You almost stopped on the spotSmashed the phone.
Your game is really poisonous!
Who wants to eat spicy rabbit head? I want to survive, okay? Would you like to move a little more coquettishly?
Two consecutive direct deaths made Mu You's heart bleed.
He finally felt the malice of this game towards the player. He had just taken a few steps and it had cheated him twice. He was not sure how he would play with him in the future!
It's a pity that the game didn't give him much time to complain, a new text has already popped up.
[Amidst the howling cold wind, you came to life again at the intersection. 】
[The experience of dying again finally makes you realize your own insignificance. In this strange and dark magical world, as a fool, you are the lowest and most humble existence. Even a rabbit on the roadside is not something you can deal with! 】
Looking at the text from Qier Baba, Mu You had to resist the urge to curse.
He was actually very curious, what was his state in that world? It doesn't matter if he can't defeat a bat or a snake, but if he can't defeat a rabbit, what kind of weakling must he be?
[After resting, you set out again to find the village. This time, you will be more cautious. 】
[You once again came to the path just now. Looking at the harmless little white rabbit in front of you, you chose to stay away from it. 】
[The rabbit quickly disappeared from your sight. You breathed a sigh of relief and continued to move forward. Suddenly you saw a wooden shop standing abruptly at the intersection in front of you. An owl-shaped signboard hung on the top of the wooden roof, which read 'Owl Shop'. 】
[The owner of the roadside shop is a man with an owl face. He sees you and greets you: "Hello adventurer, what I sell here are all genuine treasures. Don't miss it if you pass by!"]
【Do you want to enter the ‘Owl Store’? 】
There seems to be a small shop similar to a roadside stall ahead, but the owner is a strange owl man. I wonder if it is another trap.
Mu You, who was afraid of being cheated, chose [enter the store] while holding the pocket watch firmly in his right hand, ready to return immediately if anything unusual happened.
Fortunately, the imagined situation of him being bitten to death by a large group of owls as soon as he entered the store did not happen. This seemed to be a safe place for transactions.
[You enter the store and see three items on the store window. 】
[Burning Scroll: A scroll that records magic spells. After using it, you can learn the low-level fire spell 'Fire Burning'. Value: 100 years life]
[Invisibility cloak: As its name suggests, it can make you invisible after wearing it, but the cloak cannot cover up your voice and smell. Value: 55 years life]
[Charging wand: This is a special wand. Whenever someone nearby releases magic, it will absorb the spilled magic and charge one bar. After filling five bars, it can release a high-power electric shock magic without consumption and clear the charge. Value: 70-year lifespan. 】
"They are all good things!"
Mu Youchan's mouth was almost watering, but unfortunately, he couldn't afford one thing...
Even the cheapest invisibility cloak has a lifespan of 55 years, and he only has a total of 56 years now. After buying it, there is only a trace of blood left, and he will die if he is scratched by a wild monster on the roadside. Even if he was given ten courages, he would not dare to play such a big game!
